method: The platform page fetcher followed https://doi.org/<id> and read the ScienceBase landing page (title, citation, publication date, attached-file list). These are the three INGENIOUS sub-dataset DOIs catalogued as E16/E17/E18; two of them previously carried only indirect verification.
irregularity: Runner-side HTTP verification (scripts/verify_links.py) intermittently times out on sciencebase.gov DOI redirects - exactly one DOI per run, and it is a different DOI each run (P9Z6SA1Z, then P9MQRCBY; P9TWT2LU resolved). Both were resolved on the same day by the platform fetcher, so this is ScienceBase latency or bot-throttling, not a dead link. Recorded here rather than silently retried.
